summary: Implemented window-title support in Rich. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode to allow (ControlType, str). rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title). tests/test_console.py adds test_set_window_title. CHANGELOG.md has an Added entry under Unreleased. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. The legacy Windows renderer silently ignores the new control code; no Win32 path was added. The new test is unverified.
